create_CharadesEgo_dataset: create a CharadesEgo dataset instance with video params, data dir, meta dir, and split configuration
parse_charades_csv_labels: parse a CharadesEgo CSV file to extract video IDs and their action labels with class start and end times
load_metadata_for_split: load metadata CSV for train val or test split with optional subsampling and tab delimiter support
get_train_sample: get a training sample with video frames caption metadata and class target from the CharadesEgo dataset
get_val_sample: get a validation sample with video frames caption metadata and 157-dimensional action label tensor from the dataset
